title: Plan a static site carefully
summary: A cloud design should name the needed services, access rules, costs and cleanup steps. Keep a static learning site as static files.
introduction: A cloud design should name the needed services, access rules, costs and cleanup steps. Keep a static learning site as static files. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain plan a static site carefully
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A cloud design should name the needed services, access rules, costs and cleanup steps. Keep a static learning site as static files.

blocks.code:
Files: HTML, CSS, JavaScript and images
Access: read-only delivery to visitors
Origin: approved static-file storage
Review: domain, HTTPS, cache rules, cost
blocks.title: Plan a static site carefully

blocks.text: This is a deployment plan only. It introduces no user database or login backend.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Identify which part would change after updating a CSS file.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not deploy a plan until the owner approves the exact resources and cost.
For more detail later, use this [AWS further reading](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/aws-overview/introduction.html).
